newsitem.title: THAILAND: Nakornthon Schroder to raise 3 bln baht in funds.
newsitem.headline: Nakornthon Schroder to raise 3 bln baht in funds.

text.p: Nakornthon Schroder Asset Management Ltd said on Thursday it planned to raise up to three billion baht ($115 million) this year through three Thai fixed income and equity investment funds.

Nakornthon Schroder's chief investment officer Douglas Cairns told reporters his firm will float a one billion baht, open-ended fixed income fund targetted for corporate and institutional investors in April.
He said a separate equity investment fund and a fixed income fund, both for retail buyers, would also be launched before the first half of this year.
Cairns said proceeds from the funds would be invested in Thai capital market instruments and stocks.
